title: Scalar Output Extraction
description: Binding block that populates additional SCALAR output fields directly from the raw provider body root, alongside (or instead of) a `response:` resource mapping. Implementation, not CDL — reaches only scalar/semantic-typed output fields; a resource- or collection-typed output field must still go through `response:`. Validated + executed above the connector (per the accepted architecture decision extending ADD-12).

oneOf.description: JSONPath into the raw provider body root; the extracted field keeps the output field's own required-ness.

required.description: Only `false` is allowed — an extraction may loosen a required field to degrade gracefully, never tighten one.
